title: Holding cells by quiescence, then releasing them
summary: Cells can be held out of the cycle without a drug. Say where they gather when serum is taken away or the dish is crowded, and what the culture looks like once fresh medium is added.

spec.story: A dish of cultured cells (3T3-like), none of them in step. Each dot below is one cell in a sample of the dish.
spec.note: The lecture says quiescent cells gather in one main peak and move on together when released, but not how long each stage lasts, so the durations are illustrative. Held cells wait at Start, before S.

stages.label: G1 or G0
stages.note: Before DNA synthesis: 2N. Quiescent cells wait here.

treatments.label: Take away the serum
treatments.because: Without growth factors cells become quiescent and wait before S, so after a time most of the dish sits in one main 2N peak.

treatments.label: Let the dish become crowded
treatments.because: Contact inhibition makes cells quiescent too, so they gather before S and the cells further on divide and join them.

treatments.label: Take away the serum for 8 h, then add fresh medium
treatments.because: Fresh medium releases the quiescent cells together, so they leave G1 as one group and cross S side by side.
